items.title: Pay piano service invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, die Rechnung binnen 20 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum zu bezahlen.
items.computation: This is a private payment term, not a statutory administrative deadline, so §187(1) BGB applies: the triggering event (Rechnungsdatum, 19.11.2026) is not counted, and the 20-day period starts on the following day. Day 1 = 20.11.2026 ... Day 20 = 09.12.2026 (counting: 20.11, 21.11, 22.11, 23.11, 24.11, 25.11, 26.11, 27.11, 28.11, 29.11, 30.11, 01.12, 02.12, 03.12, 04.12, 05.12, 06.12, 07.12, 08.12, 09.12 = 20 days). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no §193 BGB adjustment is needed. Due date = 09.12.2026.

warnings: The customer address block shows an odd stray number ('4471') on its own line above the postal code line, which looks like a formatting/template error rather than fraud, but it's worth double-checking that the invoice is correctly addressed to you.

No Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung is expected or present since this is a private invoice, not an official decision; if you dispute the charges you would need to contact the piano service directly rather than file a formal objection.
